name: zc_beta_perf

tests.name: every stand was measured at noon and at midnight, and the clock was actually running

detail.note: a frame cost of 0.00 is what FStatUnitData reports when the stat unit overlay is not drawing, and it is under every ceiling anyone would set. Asserted here so the two clauses below cannot pass on nothing.

tests.name: the worst stand in the world holds a playable frame

detail.note: a ceiling, not a target. This is an editor PIE window on a throttling laptop, which is the harshest place Wonderland is ever drawn; a packaged build has never been measured and that gap is listed as a beta blocker rather than estimated away.

tests.name: the moon's second shadow-casting light is affordable

detail.note: midnight now runs a second directional light with two cascades, plus a small unshadowed lamp on the Dog. This is what that costs, measured in the same session as the noon figure it is subtracted from.
